28: ## 3. Tier 2 — Bean Base HTTP client

Timer use justified in a header comment: the API's wall-clock rate window is genuinely temporal (like polling/heartbeats), not an event-suppression guard.

148: ## 7B. Tier 3 — MCP read/write of per-shot Bean Base snapshots
149: 
150: > Added per user direction (June 2026): MCP must be able to update Bean Base
151: > entries on historical shots. Snapshot semantics confirmed: we SAVE the data
152: > per shot, never just reference Bean Base's id — their `historical=true`
153: > Dev-tier gating implies entries get delisted/mutated, so history must not
154: > depend on their retention. (Bag images remain URLs into their CDN — text
155: > data survives deletion, photos may not; local image caching would be a
